tr: Varus R root + yakındaki şampiyonlara yayılma → Orianna R zincire burst

name: Chain Binding
ability_ref: Varus R (Chain of Corruption) roots multiple enemies → Morgana Q (Dark Binding) 3-second root on primary target extends lockdown beyond Varus R duration
tr: Varus R zincir root → Morgana Q uzatılmış root; extended lockdown

name: Tidal Bullet Time
ability_ref: Nami R (Tidal Wave) long-range knockup wave hits enemy frontline → Miss Fortune R (Bullet Time) channels during knockup/slow window
tr: Nami R knockup dalgası → Miss Fortune R knockup/slow penceresinde full kanal

name: Nature's Bullet Time
ability_ref: Maokai R (Nature's Grasp) slow+root line significantly restricts enemy movement; Miss Fortune R (Bullet Time) channels in this window. 'Nobody can escape for full duration' is not guaranteed — shields/cleanse/Zhonya can reduce channel damage.
tr: Maokai R slow+root kısıtlama → Miss Fortune R channel penceresi

name: Snowball Bandage
ability_ref: Nunu W (Biggest Snowball Ever!) charge knocks up enemies at impact → Amumu R (Curse of the Sad Mummy) AOE stun/lockdown at Nunu's arrival location; double CC wave
tr: Nunu W charge knockup → Amumu R AOE stun/lockdown; çift CC dalgası

name: Berserk Rampage
ability_ref: Renata R (Hostile Takeover) berserk effects cause chaotic teamfight; if Jinx receives a takedown/assist contribution during this window, passive (Get Excited!) reset can trigger. Synergy is indirect and conditional — berserk producing kill credit for Jinx is not guaranteed.
tr: Renata R berserk kaos → Jinx takedown/assist katkısıyla reset; koşullu

name: Stone Ice
ability_ref: Taliyah E (Unraveled Earth) sets stone trap field → W (Seismic Shove) pushes enemies through E stones for damage + slow window → Lissandra R (Frozen Tomb) on slowed primary target or self-cast + AOE slow zone on remaining enemies
tr: Taliyah E+W hasar/slow penceresi → Lissandra R lockdown veya self AOE zone

name: Gold Mark
ability_ref: Twisted Fate R (Destiny) global vision + teleport to sidelane; W (Gold Card) stun on target. Zed does NOT global teleport — Zed follow-up requires prior roam to the same lane or proximity. If Zed is nearby, R (Death Mark) assassination follow-up. Map pressure via TF; Zed contribution is local.
tr: Twisted Fate R global TF baskısı + stun; Zed lokal roam ile assassination

name: Onslaught Shockwave
ability_ref: Sion R (Unstoppable Onslaught) creates knockup window on enemies contacted at impact zone → Orianna R (Command:Shockwave) follow-up burst at Sion's landing point. Not all enemies are guaranteed to be knocked up — only those in Sion's path are affected.
tr: Sion R impact knockup penceresi → Orianna R landing noktasına follow-up burst

name: Cyclone Shockwave
ability_ref: Wukong R (Cyclone) AOE knockup spin → Orianna R (Command: Shockwave) burst on grouped airborne enemies
tr: Wukong R AOE knockup → Orianna R grup burst

name: Moonfall Shockwave
ability_ref: Diana R (Lunar Rush / Moonfall) pulls enemies together → Orianna R (Command: Shockwave) on the clumped group
tr: Diana R grup toplama → Orianna R burst

name: Solar Flare Combo
ability_ref: Leona E (Zenith Blade) dash + R (Solar Flare) stun + Q (Shield of Daybreak) → Lucian burst on locked target
tr: Leona E+R+Q lockdown → Lucian burst

name: Hero's Entrance
ability_ref: Galio R (Hero's Entrance) channels to ally then AOE knockup + taunt on landing → Zed R (Death Mark) burst follow-up
tr: Galio R AOE knockup+taunt → Zed R burst

name: Death Sentence Trap
ability_ref: Thresh Q (Death Sentence) hook isolates target → Caitlyn W (Yordle Snap Trap) / R (Ace in the Hole) execute on the held target
tr: Thresh Q hook → Caitlyn trap/R execute

name: Dredge Line Lockdown
ability_ref: Nautilus Q (Dredge Line) hook + R (Depth Charge) knockup → Jinx free auto-attack reset and R follow-up
tr: Nautilus Q hook + R knockup → Jinx serbest hasar

name: Fate's Call Engage
ability_ref: Thresh stands as Kalista's Soul-bound ally; Kalista R (Fate's Call) launches Thresh into the enemy backline → Thresh Q hook / E (Flay) + Box on landing
tr: Kalista R Thresh'i fırlatır → Thresh hook+Flay engage

name: Showstopper Entrance
ability_ref: Galio R (Hero's Entrance) AOE knockup+taunt groups enemies → Sett R (The Show Stopper) slams a carried enemy into the clustered group for AOE slow+damage
tr: Galio R grup taunt → Sett R AOE slam

name: Mega Knockup Tempest
ability_ref: Gnar R (GNAR!) AOE knockup/stun when enemies are pinned against terrain → Yasuo R (Last Breath) on airborne enemies
tr: Gnar R AOE knockup → Yasuo R havadakilere
